serviceName: AuthorSend author website on a subdomain
description: Points a subdomain (such as books.yourname.com) at your AuthorSend author website and proves you own it, so its security certificate can be issued.
variableDescription: acmname, acmvalue: the certificate's DNS validation record for the subdomain, as Amazon Certificate Manager issued it (_<acmname>.<subdomain> CNAME _<acmvalue>.acm-validations.aws).
